goal.tpl_1: What a strike! {player} finds the back of the net!
goal.tpl_2: Brilliant finish! {player} curls it into the corner!
goal.tpl_3: Unstoppable! {player} smashes it into the roof of the net!
goal.quality_excellent: An absolute screamer that will be remembered for years!
goal.quality_chance: He made it look so easy!

center_with_assist.tpl_0: GOAL! {pusher} drives through the middle, finds {assist} who slides a pass to {shooter} — {shooter} {quality} past the keeper!
center_with_assist.tpl_1: {pusher} orchestrates through the middle, {assist} threads a needle through the defense, and {shooter} {quality} into the net! {tackler} never stood a chance.
center_with_assist.tpl_2: Textbook central build-up! {pusher} picks up the ball at the edge of the box, exchanges a one-two with {assist} that splits the defense, and {shooter} {quality} low into the bottom corner! {tackler} slides in too late to stop it.
center_with_assist.tpl_3: Watch {pusher} at the heart of this move — he drops deep to collect, fakes a switch to the wing, then whips a through-ball into the path of {shooter}! {shooter} rounds the keeper and {quality} into the empty net! {tackler} and the entire back four are left flat-footed as the {team} bench erupts!

center_no_assist.tpl_0: GOAL! {shooter} beats two men through the middle and {quality} past the keeper!
center_no_assist.tpl_1: {pusher} picks up the ball centrally, beats two defenders on his own, and {quality} into the net! {tackler} caught ball-watching.
center_no_assist.tpl_2: {pusher} decides to take on the entire midfield himself — he skips past two challenges, drives into the box, and {shooter} {quality} low past the keeper! {tackler} slides in too late. Solo run, solo goal!
center_no_assist.tpl_3: Watch {pusher} at the edge of the area — he drops a shoulder to send {tackler} the wrong way, then drives past the second defender into the box! Rather than squaring to a teammate, {shooter} {quality} into the top corner! {tackler} can only stand and watch. A moment of pure individual brilliance that brings the stadium to its feet!

left_with_assist.tpl_0: GOAL! {pusher} drives down the left, crosses to {shooter} who volleys home!
left_with_assist.tpl_1: {pusher} shifts past {tackler} on the left and centers for {shooter}, who {quality} from close range!
left_with_assist.tpl_2: {pusher} receives from {assist} on the left flank, fakes out {tackler} with a stepover, then delivers a curling cross! {shooter} ghosts in at the far post and {quality} header into the net!
left_with_assist.tpl_3: Watch {pusher} on the left touchline — he picks up {assist}'s pass, kills it dead, then sends {tackler} the wrong way with a body feint! The cross that follows is inch-perfect, curling away from the keeper, and {shooter} arrives unmarked to {quality} into the roof of the net! The left flank has been {team}'s weapon all match and this is the payoff!

left_no_assist.tpl_0: {pusher} carries all the way down the left, cuts inside, and {quality} into the far corner!
left_no_assist.tpl_1: {pusher} receives on the left, beats {tackler} one-on-one, and {quality} curls it into the top corner!
left_no_assist.tpl_2: {pusher} uses raw pace to burn past {tackler} down the left, drives into the box, and {shooter} {quality} low past the keeper! {tackler} slides in too late.
left_no_assist.tpl_3: Watch {pusher} on the left touchline — he holds off {tackler}'s challenge with his body, then shifts his weight to send the defender sliding past! Into the box now, and rather than squaring to the unmarked runner, {shooter} {quality} a curler into the top corner! {tackler} can only watch. A winger's goal — pure individual brilliance!

right_with_assist.tpl_0: GOAL! {pusher} drives down the right, crosses, and {shooter} heads it in!
right_with_assist.tpl_1: {pusher} combines with {assist} on the right, crosses low, and {shooter} {quality} at the near post!
right_with_assist.tpl_2: {pusher} receives from {assist} on the right, fakes out {tackler}, and whips a low cross into the six-yard box! {shooter} arrives unmarked and {quality} into the net!
right_with_assist.tpl_3: Watch {pusher} on the right — he takes {assist}'s pass in stride, sells {tackler} a dummy with a shoulder drop, then fires a low, hard cross along the six-yard line! {shooter} arrives a step ahead of his marker and {quality} a first-time finish! The right channel is alive for {team}!

right_no_assist.tpl_0: {pusher} carries down the right, cuts inside, and {quality} into the bottom corner!
right_no_assist.tpl_1: {pusher} receives on the right, beats {tackler} one-on-one, and {quality} curls it past the keeper!
right_no_assist.tpl_2: {pusher} uses pace to burn past {tackler} down the right, drives into the box, and {shooter} {quality} low past the keeper!
right_no_assist.tpl_3: Watch {pusher} on the right touchline — he leaves {tackler} on the floor with a stepover, drives into the box, and {shooter} {quality} a curler into the top corner! A winger's solo run, finished in style!

long_shot.tpl_0: WHAT A STRIKE! {shooter} lets fly from 30 yards and the ball swerves into the top corner!
long_shot.tpl_1: {shooter} picks up the ball 30 yards from goal and hammers a screamer into the top corner! {tackler} had no chance.
long_shot.tpl_2: Watch {shooter} at the edge of the D — he feints a pass to the wing, then unleashes a dipping, swerving right-footer! {tackler} scrambles across but the ball dips under the bar and into the net!
long_shot.tpl_3: Sensational! {shooter} collects from {pusher} at the top of the D, takes one touch to set himself, and curls a swerving left-footer that bends away from {tackler}'s despairing dive! The ball clips the underside of the bar and bounces down — goal-line technology confirms it. The stadium erupts!

penalty.tpl_0: Penalty scored! {shooter} sends the keeper the wrong way and {quality} into the corner!
penalty.tpl_1: {shooter} steps up to the spot, stutters in the run-up, and {quality} into the bottom corner! Ice cold.
penalty.tpl_2: Watch {shooter} at the spot — he waits for the keeper to commit, then dinks the panenka down the middle! {tackler} dives the wrong way and can only watch the ball ripple the net. Nerve of steel.
penalty.tpl_3: Huge moment! {shooter} places the ball, takes a long, slow run-up to unsettle {tackler}, then side-foots a perfect penalty into the bottom corner! The keeper guessed right but couldn't get there. {team} take the lead!

header.tpl_0: GOAL! {pusher} swings a cross into the box, {shooter} rises highest and powers a header past the keeper!
header.tpl_1: Header, goal! {shooter} meets {pusher}'s delivery from the {lane} and {quality} into the net!
header.tpl_2: Brilliant from {shooter}! {pusher} whips it in from the {lane}, {shooter} times the jump and nods it home!
header.tpl_3: The cross comes in from {pusher} on the {lane} — {shooter} peels off his marker, climbs above the defender, and crashes a header past the keeper! {tackler} never had a chance. Textbook centre-forward's goal.

one_on_one.tpl_0: GOAL! Through ball from {pusher} splits the defence and {shooter} is clean through — he slots it past the keeper!
one_on_one.tpl_1: One-on-one, goal! {shooter} keeps his head and {quality} past the onrushing keeper!
one_on_one.tpl_2: Brilliant pass from {pusher} and {shooter} races through! He holds his nerve and tucks it into the far corner!
one_on_one.tpl_3: Counter-attack and {shooter} is away! He rounds the keeper... no, slots it under him with a delicate chip! {tackler} gets a hand to it but can't stop the ball rolling into the net!

rebound.tpl_0: GOAL! The initial effort is blocked but {shooter} reacts quickest and pokes home the rebound!
rebound.tpl_1: Rebound goal! {shooter} stays alert in the box and taps in after the keeper parries!
rebound.tpl_2: The shot is saved, the keeper spills it — {shooter} is there to smash the rebound into the roof of the net!
rebound.tpl_3: Chaos in the box! The initial effort is blocked, the ball loops back to {shooter} who volleys it into the empty net! {tackler} can only watch. Poacher's instinct.

shot_on_target.tpl_0: {player} fires one in — the keeper pulls off a superb save!
shot_on_target.tpl_1: {player} unleashes a fierce drive, but the keeper is equal to it!
shot_on_target.tpl_2: The keeper shows great reflexes to palm away {player}'s effort!
shot_on_target.tpl_3: {player} forces the keeper into action with a powerful shot!

long_shot.tpl_0: {shooter} lets fly from distance — the keeper tips it over the bar!
long_shot.tpl_1: Watch {shooter} at the top of the D — a dipping, swerving effort, but the keeper reads it and tips it wide!

header.tpl_0: {pusher} swings it in from the {lane}, {shooter} meets it with his head — but the keeper tips it over!
header.tpl_1: Powerful header from {shooter} but the keeper makes a sharp save and palms it away!
header.tpl_2: Free header for {shooter} in the box — the keeper reacts brilliantly to keep it out!
header.tpl_3: The cross from {pusher} finds {shooter} free in the box, his header is goal-bound but {tackler} somehow claws it off the line!

one_on_one.tpl_0: One-on-one and the keeper saves! {shooter} tries to slot it past but {tackler} stands tall!
one_on_one.tpl_1: {shooter} is through on goal but the keeper rushes out and smothers the shot!
one_on_one.tpl_2: Clean through on goal, {shooter} tries to round the keeper but {tackler} stays big and blocks it with his legs!
one_on_one.tpl_3: Brilliant pass sends {shooter} clean through! He shoots low but {tackler} gets down well and saves with his foot!

rebound.tpl_0: The initial shot is saved but the rebound falls to {shooter} — the keeper gets up quickly to block the follow-up!
rebound.tpl_1: Two saves in one move! The keeper parries, {shooter} tries to convert the rebound but the keeper recovers brilliantly!
rebound.tpl_2: Saved first time, blocked second time — {shooter} just can't get it past the keeper from the rebound!
rebound.tpl_3: The shot comes in, the keeper parries, the rebound falls to {shooter} in the six-yard box — but {tackler} reacts faster and smothers it before he can shoot!

shot_off_target.tpl_0: So close! {player}'s shot drifts just wide of the post!
shot_off_target.tpl_1: {player} couldn't keep it down — over the bar!
shot_off_target.tpl_2: agony for {player}! The ball clips the post and goes out!

long_shot.tpl_0: {shooter} tries his luck from 30 yards but drags it just wide!
long_shot.tpl_1: Watch {shooter} let fly from distance — the keeper watches it whistle past the post!

header.tpl_0: {pusher} whips a cross in, {shooter} rises to meet it but heads over the bar!
header.tpl_1: Free header for {shooter} from {pusher}'s cross — but he puts it over the bar!
header.tpl_2: The cross from {pusher} is perfect, {shooter} gets above his marker but nods it wide!
header.tpl_3: {shooter} meets the cross cleanly but the header is just over the bar — agonising.

one_on_one.tpl_0: One-on-one and {shooter} drags it wide! Big miss!
one_on_one.tpl_1: Clean through, {shooter} tries to place it but pulls it past the post!
one_on_one.tpl_2: Through ball, {shooter} is in on goal — he lifts it over the keeper but it's just over the bar!
one_on_one.tpl_3: {shooter} is clean through, tries to round the keeper but over-runs it — ball goes out for a goal kick. Should have scored.

rebound.tpl_0: The rebound falls to {shooter} in the box but he blazes it over from close range!
rebound.tpl_1: Saved! {shooter} tries to convert the rebound but scoops it over the bar!
rebound.tpl_2: The ball breaks kindly to {shooter} in the six-yard box but he miscues and sends it wide!
rebound.tpl_3: Parried by the keeper, falls to {shooter} — but the angle is tight and he drags the rebound wide. Big let-off.

save.tpl_0: World-class save! The keeper bails out his team!
save.tpl_1: Absolutely brilliant stop! The keeper is unbeatable today!
save.tpl_2: Can you believe that? An incredible double save!
save.tpl_3: Watch {shooter} fire this one in — {team}'s keeper palms it over the bar! World-class reflexes and the home crowd goes wild.

foul.tpl_0: {team} with a heavy challenge — the referee blows his whistle!
foul.tpl_1: Foul on {team}! {player} is giving away a free kick.
foul.tpl_2: {team} caught pushing in the box — {player} the offender.

turnover.tpl_0: Turnover at {team} — possession lost in the middle of the park.
turnover.tpl_1: {tackler} steps in sharply to dispossess {player} — {team} give the ball away cheaply.
turnover.tpl_2: {pusher} tries to play through the middle but {tackler} reads it perfectly! Ball poked away, and {tacklerTeam} are off — they're launching a quick counter before {team} can reset!
turnover.tpl_3: This could be a turning point! {pusher} receives in the center circle and tries to turn past {tackler}, but the defender anticipates perfectly and pokes the ball through! {tacklerTeam} are already breaking at pace — {tackler} is storming into the {team} half. The turnover has turned into a 3-v-2 before the back four can recover!

free_kick.tpl_0: Free kick to {team} — {player} lines it up.
free_kick.tpl_1: {team} win a set piece. {player} stands over the ball.
free_kick.tpl_2: {foulingTeam} give away a free kick in a dangerous area! {player} stands over the ball, and {team}'s big men are lining up in the box — the tension is palpable!
free_kick.tpl_3: Dangerous free kick for {team} after a clumsy challenge by {foulingTeam}! {player} places the ball down, the wall is set, and {team} have sent three runners into the box to peel off markers. One swing of the boot could change this game!

offside.tpl_0: The assistant's flag goes up — {team} caught offside.
offside.tpl_1: Clever play by the defense! {team} falls into the offside trap!

corner.tpl_0: {team} earns a corner kick. Let's see what they can create here.
corner.tpl_1: {team} with a corner — the big men are queuing up in the box!
corner.tpl_2: {team} win a corner on the {lane}! {player} stands over the ball, six players are crammed into the box, and the defenders are jostling for position. This could be a set-piece chance!
corner.tpl_3: Corner for {team} on the {lane}! {player} is sizing up the delivery while the box fills up — at least six players from both sides are battling for position. {tackler} has his arms wrapped around his man. A goal here would be devastating!

yellow_card.tpl_0: Yellow card! The referee shows a warning to {player}{reason}.
yellow_card.tpl_1: {player} is booked for a tactical foul{reason}.

red_card.tpl_0: RED CARD! {player} is sent off! Their team is in trouble now!
red_card.tpl_1: No hesitation from the referee — straight red for {player}!

substitution.tpl_0: Substitution: {playerIn} gets ready to come on — {team} looking to freshen things up.
substitution.tpl_1: Change for {team} — {playerIn} is warming up to enter the pitch.
substitution.tpl_2: The manager is making changes on the touchline.

injury.tpl_1: {player} looks in pain as he stays down{severity}. Medical staff are coming on.
injury.tpl_2: Play is stopped as {player} receives treatment{severity}.

clearance.tpl_0: {team} with a crucial clearance under pressure!
clearance.tpl_1: {team} defender gets there first and boots it to safety!

interception.tpl_0: {team} reads that beautifully and intercepts the pass!
interception.tpl_1: Perfectly timed tackle by {team}! They've won the ball back!

penalty.tpl_0: PENALTY! The referee points to the spot — what a chance for {team}!
penalty.tpl_1: {team} wins a penalty! The entire stadium holds its breath!
penalty.tpl_2: PENALTY! {foulingTeam}'s {fouler} brings down the attacker in the box! The referee points to the spot and {team} have a chance from 12 yards!
penalty.tpl_3: Crucial moment! {foulingTeam}'s {fouler} clatters into the {team} attacker in the area and the referee has no hesitation — penalty! {team} players mob the kicker, {foulingTeam} look devastated. The kicker places the ball on the spot as the stadium goes quiet.

penalty_miss.tpl_0: Oh no! The penalty is missed! {player} couldn't handle the pressure.
penalty_miss.tpl_1: How did that miss? {player} blazes it over from the spot!
penalty_miss.tpl_2: Saved! {player} steps up for {team} but {tackler} guesses right and palms it away! A huge let-off for {team}'s opponents.
penalty_miss.tpl_3: Watch {player} at the spot for {team} — he stutters in the run-up but {tackler} doesn't bite! The keeper dives the right way and pushes it wide! {player} falls to his knees, {team} have blown a huge chance. The visiting end goes absolutely wild!

half_time.tpl_0: Half-time whistle! {homeTeam} {homeScore} : {awayScore} {awayTeam} — players head to the dressing room.

full_time.tpl_0: Full-time! The final score: {homeTeam} {homeScore} : {awayScore} {awayTeam} — {winner} claims all three points!
full_time.tpl_1: That's it! {homeTeam} vs {awayTeam} ends {homeScore} : {awayScore}. Congratulations to {winner}!
full_time.tpl_2: Final whistle! {winner} shows why they're champions with a dominant display!
full_time.draw: It's a draw after 90 minutes — both teams share the spoils!

kickoff.tpl_0: And we're off! The referee blows the whistle and we're underway!

second_half_start.tpl_0: Second half kicks off! Let's see what the next 45 minutes bring.

extra_time_start.tpl_0: Thirty more minutes to decide this. Extra time begins!

penalty_start.tpl_0: It's time for the ultimate test — penalty shootout! Nerves of steel needed now.

forfeit.tpl_0: {forfeitingTeam} has forfeited the match. {winner} takes the three points by walkover.
forfeit.tpl_1: Match awarded to {winner}. {forfeitingTeam} failed to show.
